name: Resource drift
short_description: Any change to infrastructure managed by Terraform that Terraform did not make, so that the real environment no longer matches the configuration and state. It is detected with a plan or a refresh-only plan.

evidence.quote: Your team guesses at drift when reality quietly changes.
